links.outcome: Temporal agreement and event recovery with versus without structured-evidence source-row grounding
links.effect: GLM 5.2 multimodal revision improved temporal agreement over text-only without reducing event recovery; adjudication favored multimodal for GLM 5.2 but not DeepSeek V3.2; other models showed smaller gains.
links.quote: Ablations showed that UIDs primarily preserve event retention, whereas source-row linkage supports temporal placement.

unlisted_practices: UID-preserving occurrence-level provenance linking generated timeline events to source text spans
LLM-as-judge adjudication of AI outputs against source record with blinded human review of judge findings

screen.reason: Evaluates the impact of grounding narrative clinical event reconstruction with structured-evidence retrieval and timestamped source-row provenance (UID preservation) versus text-only baseline, including blinded clinician adjudication.

primary.practice: source-grounded multimodal retrieval and UID-preserving provenance tracking
